This segment tracks QazaqGaz's 'second line' (BBS-2) project, and every independent source describes it as an entirely NEW parallel gas pipeline (~1,450 km), not a compressor-only throughput boost: qazprojects.com's project tracker gives length ~1,450 km, phase 'Procurement & Construction' (Aug 2025-Dec 2026), $1,000M contract value, and names three construction contractors assigned by lot (EHZ, MCC, KazStroyService); QazaqGaz's own IGO 2024 report titles it 'Строительство второй линии магистрального газопровода' (construction of a second MAIN PIPELINE line) and separately lists a genuinely capacity-only historical upgrade (Turkestan compressor station, 2012-2019, raised the ORIGINAL line from 10 to 15 bcm/y with no new pipe) as a distinct, already-completed item -- so GEM has conflated a real new-build project with the 'capacity expansion only' pattern that correctly describes the Turkestan-type upgrade. Not proposing a length/diameter/route value myself (no corridor/geometry source in hand, and the orchestrator scope note directs against fabricating one for this PID) -- flagging for Update/route-creation review instead.
validity.researcher_notes: P6712 is GEM's 'Segment III (Capacity expansion)' row for Beineu-Bozoy-Shymkent (BBS), values: Capacity=5.00 bcm/y, ConstructionYear=2027, StartYear1=2029, SegmentCost=$6.9bn (2024), LengthKnownKm=0.00, RouteType='Capacity expansion only'. Existence of the underlying project is solid: QazaqGaz's own 2024 Integrated Annual Report (igo_qazaqgaz_2024.pdf) documents JV 'Beineu-Bozoi-Shymkent 2 Ltd' formed 28 June 2024 (50% QazaqGaz / 50% UCC Qazaqstan 6 LLC, part of Qatar's UCC Holding) to build a second line of BBS, staged 'Этап 1: 2024-2026' / 'Этап 2: 2027-2029', total cost '6,9 млрд долл. США', target design capacity of the new line 'до 15 млрд м3 в год', raising total system throughput from 15 to 30 bcm/y. Corroborated independently: kt.kz (May 2024, QazaqGaz-UCC Holding consensus on 4 projects incl. BBS-2), forbes.kz (Feb 2024, JV signing w/ Qatar's Power International Holding for the same 15 bcm/y second line), kursiv.media (Feb 2024, cost ~2.7 trillion tenge / 15 bcm/y, TEO due Q2 2024, target launch 2027), primeminister.kz (31 Jul 2025 press conference: second-line construction physically started April 2025, commissioning targeted end of 2026 -- i.e. Stage 1), inbusiness.kz (13 Jul 2024, reporting the Chinese partner in the ORIGINAL line had not signed off on the second-line project, underscoring it is a distinct new build requiring first-line partner consent -- which would only matter if it is genuinely new parallel pipe). qazprojects.com's project-tracker entry for 'Beineu-Bozoy-Shymkent Gas Pipeline (second line)' independently gives length ~1,450 km and a live 2025-2026 construction-procurement phase worth $1,000M, naming actual contractors -- this is the strongest single piece of evidence that real pipe-laying, not just compressor upgrades, is underway. None of this evidence supports treating the project as capacity-only with zero length. ConstructionYear=2027/StartYear1=2029 do line up with the IGO2024 report's 'Этап 2: 2027-2029' window, so if GEM intends Segment III specifically as the SECOND of the JV's two build stages, the timing fields are consistent -- but even a second construction stage of a genuinely new pipe should not carry LengthKnownKm=0 / RouteType='Capacity expansion only'. Recommend routing this to Update for a classification decision, and to route-creation only once/if a real corridor source can be found (not fabricated).

validity.researcher_notes: Two spec-level problems, both on this row's numeric fields: (1) Capacity=5.00 bcm/y. No source I could fetch and verify states a stage-specific capacity increment for 'Segment III' / Stage 2 (2027-2029). Every citable, verified source only gives the AGGREGATE second-line design figure: 'до 15 млрд м3 в год' (new line design capacity) / system total rising from 15 to 30 bcm/y (IGO2024 pdf; kursiv 2024-02-23; forbes.kz). A web-search snippet suggested a 10 bcm/y (stage 1) + reaching 15 bcm/y (stage 2) split, sourced to vlast.kz coverage of a September-2023 gas-infrastructure roadmap, which would reconcile GEM's '5' as the stage-2 increment -- but both vlast.kz URLs 403'd on fetch (anti-bot), so I could not verify that claim myself and am not citing it. The row's current ref for Capacity is adilet.zan.kz/G23JVM00350#z250 (the September 2023 General Gasification Scheme order) cited 3x identically -- this order predates the BBS-2 JV's formation (28 June 2024) by 9 months, so it is unlikely to name this specific project's capacity figure at all; the existing automated check that passed it is almost certainly a coincidental substring hit on the digit '5' in a large legal document, not genuine coverage. (2) SegmentCost=$6.9bn/2024 matches the IGO2024 report's 'Общая стоимость: 6,9 млрд долл. США' exactly -- but that figure is explicitly the TOTAL cost for BOTH stages (2024-2026 AND 2027-2029) of the whole second-line project, not a Stage-2-only cost. If this Segment III row is meant to represent only Stage 2, attributing the full project cost to it risks double-counting if another GEM row/segment for this same BBS-2 project also carries a cost figure. I could not check this against sibling segments (out of this row's data); flagging for the batch owner to check across all BBS-related rows before this figure is treated as settled. Note also a secondary, non-independent cost estimate: kursiv.media (2024-02-23, pre-JV) gave 2.7 trillion tenge (~$5.6-6.0bn at 2024 FX), noticeably lower than the eventual $6.9bn -- consistent with normal cost escalation between an early 2024 estimate and the JV's later official figure, not a contradiction, but not a second confirmation of $6.9bn either.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The BBS second-line project as a WHOLE is now actively under construction: the 2025-07-31 primeminister.kz press conference states construction began April 2025 with commissioning targeted end of 2026, and QazaqGaz's own IGO2024 report frames the project as two stages, 'Этап 1: 2024-2026' (matches the started construction) and 'Этап 2: 2027-2029'. This row's own ConstructionYear=2027/StartYear1=2029 fields point specifically at the SECOND of those two stages, which per all dated evidence found has not itself begun (only Stage 1, 2024-2026, is in construction as of mid-2025/mid-2026). On that reading, 'proposed' remains the defensible status for this specific segment pending 2027, so I am confirming rather than proposing a change -- but flag that this hinges on Segment III genuinely mapping to Stage 2 and not simply being GEM's single row for the entire project (in which case 'construction' would be more accurate now); see the classification concern in `validity` for the related doubt about what this segment actually represents. The ref cited on the sheet for Status (adilet G23JVM00350) does not itself state 'proposed' in any checkable way -- it is a 2023 planning order, not a status register -- so I am not relying on it; my confirm rests on the primeminister.kz + IGO2024 evidence above.
